name: Segawa Izumi
source:
Likes: Everyone
Dislikes: Nothing

Izumi is the class president of Hayate's class at Hakuo Academy and a part of The Hakuo Three Amiga with Miki and Risa. Izumi is a lively and bubbly person who is always seen with a smile and has a cheerful disposition. Like her friends, she addresses Hayate as "Hayata".

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Izumi_Segawa]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
